updates.title: CVE-2026-83711: Azure AD B2C Authorization Bypass
updates.summary: An authorization bypass vulnerability in Azure AD B2C allows unauthorized attackers to escalate privileges over the network by exploiting user-controlled keys. This critical flaw affects identity and access control and requires immediate patching to prevent unauthorized access to B2C tenants.

updates.title: CVE-2026-70352: Azure AI Language Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: A missing authentication vulnerability in Azure AI Language enables unauthorized attackers to escalate privileges over the network by accessing critical functions without proper verification. Organizations using Azure AI Language should apply security updates immediately.

updates.title: CVE-2026-70178: Microsoft Fabric Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: Missing authorization controls in Microsoft Fabric allow authorized attackers to elevate privileges across the network. Admins should prioritize patching to prevent privilege escalation in Fabric workspaces.

updates.title: Microsoft Entra Domain Services Enhanced sAMAccountName Support
updates.summary: Microsoft Entra Domain Services now supports synchronizing the Security Accounts Manager account name (sAMAccountName) from on-premises directory attributes, improving hybrid identity alignment and reducing manual account name configuration. This feature is in public preview and enabled by default for new managed domains.

updates.title: Microsoft Entra ID Backup & Recovery with 30-Day Retention
updates.summary: Organizations can now recover Entra objects to a point-in-time state over a rolling 30-day window, extending beyond the standard 7-day recovery included with P1/P2 licenses. This capability enables admins to restore from accidental deletions or malicious changes with greater flexibility.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention Policies for Non-Microsoft Connected Apps
updates.summary: DLP policies can now protect sensitive data at rest in non-Microsoft applications such as Box and Google Workspace using existing Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps connectors and Microsoft's classification engine. This extends data protection governance beyond Microsoft 365 ecosystems.

updates.title: Sensitivity Label Policies for Non-Microsoft Connected Apps
updates.summary: Auto-labeling policies now support non-Microsoft connected apps including Box and Google Workspace, allowing organizations to enforce consistent sensitivity labeling across hybrid cloud environments. This uses the same Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps connectors and classification engine.

updates.title: Auto-Labeling Policy Simulation Mode for Sensitivity Labels
updates.summary: Administrators can now run auto-labeling policies in simulation mode to validate labeling decisions before enforcement, reviewing match results and source distribution to ensure accuracy. This reduces risk of incorrect classifications in production environments.

updates.title: DLP Default Protection Controls for Exchange Online Classification Failures
updates.summary: Administrators can now configure granular DLP policies based on specific classification failure types—such as timeouts and throttling—rather than applying a blanket policy for all failures. This feature is in public preview for Exchange Online.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention SLA-Based Alert Reporting Dashboard
updates.summary: A new out-of-box dashboard provides visibility into alert metrics (MTTA, MTTD, MTTR), trending data, and top sensitive information types exposed via DLP alerts, with customizable SLAs for different severity levels. This helps security teams measure operational performance against their defined response targets.

updates.title: Rights Management Connector Moving to Certificate-Based Authentication
updates.summary: The Microsoft Rights Management connector is migrating from shared-secret authentication to certificate-based authentication, improving security posture. Administrators will configure their own Microsoft Entra app registration and certificate, then use new PowerShell cmdlets to manage certificate deployment across workloads.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Auto-Labeling Scalability and Policy Management Enhancements
updates.summary: Purview is expanding auto-labeling support for larger SharePoint scopes while improving policy management flexibility and providing richer visibility into labeling activity. These enhancements enable organizations to deploy consistent labeling at enterprise scale.

updates.title: Data Lifecycle Management Archive Expansion Beyond 1.5TB
updates.summary: Auto-expanding archive mailboxes can now grow beyond the previous 1.5TB limit, ensuring uninterrupted retention and scalable archive growth. This capability is available to customers with eligible E5 licenses and prevents mailboxes from becoming inoperative.

updates.title: Data Lifecycle Management Azure PST Import
updates.summary: Organizations can now import PST files stored in Azure Blob Storage directly into Exchange Online mailboxes using a two-step Exchange Migration Service pattern with analysis and validation phases. This streamlines cloud migration workflows for on-premises mail data.

updates.title: Information Protection Scanner Data Export for Custom Reporting
updates.summary: The information protection scanner now exports labeling, classification, and protection action data to SQL tables, enabling administrators to create custom reports and gain visibility into repository scanning states. This supports compliance reporting and governance analytics.
